_comment: Which kit skills belong to which capability module. project-init reads this to install only the modules a project needs, and to build the copy SKIP list for the rest. A project installs `shared` plus every module it chose; choosing none installs no skills. Keep in sync with the skill folders under files/.claude/skills/.

dev.desc: building to a contract: interface and data-model design, the design system, secure implementation, and recorded decisions

qa.desc: requirements-driven testing: shared craft, case design, authoring, execution, triage, and a browser driver

ops.desc: shipping and incidents: release gating, blameless incident handling

platforms._comment: frontend splits by target. The shared `frontend` installs with the dev module; project-init installs only the chosen platforms' delta skills and leaves the rest out, so a web project never carries the mobile rules.
